files.description: Playwright tests for the settings feature: media directory add/remove with validation and confirm dialog, application language switch with restore, distance unit persistence, thumbnail directory move (stats stream + counted confirmation + move-back), classification label vocabulary add/remove, and the System Information section.

testContext: /settings is section-based. Media dirs: #media-dirs-list with .media-dir-item rows (.media-dir-path text + [data-action=remove-media-dir]); add via #new-media-dir input + [data-action=add-media-dir] which POSTs /api/settings/media-dirs (the server mkdirs the path, so a scratch dir under the sandbox root always works); empty path -> toast 'Please enter a directory path'; success toasts are .notification.visible. Removal confirms via #global-confirm-dialog then DELETEs /api/settings/media-dirs/<index>. NEVER remove the seeded library dir — other suites depend on it; the 'No media directories configured' empty state is therefore not asserted. The sandbox root is derived from System Information's 'Database Path:' <code> (exact-text match — 'Database Path:' is a substring of 'Task Queue Database Path:'). Language/units are native selects (#application-locale, #distance-unit) hidden behind searchable-select widgets; the Save buttons live in form[action$="/settings/locale"] / form[action$="/settings/distance-unit"] (NOT inside the .form-group). A locale change re-renders server-side: assert html[lang] and translated text (es: 'Ajustes'); restore by setting the hidden select value via evaluate so the restore is label-independent. Locale changes are global — other parallel suites assert English strings, so keep the non-English window short. Thumbnail dir: #current-thumbnail-dir code, stats stream fills #thumbnail-count/#thumbnail-size on load (NDJSON /settings/thumbnail-stats/stream); [data-action=change-thumbnail-dir] fetches stats then confirms via the global dialog whose message includes 'New location: <dir>' and 'This will move N files (SIZE)'; confirming POSTs /api/settings/thumbnail-dir (moves files + updates DB paths) and reloads; the test moves to a sibling dir and moves back in finally. Labels vocabulary is the same #labels-section the labels suite covers (chips .label-chip, .add-label-form, .label-chip-remove); this suite only does a quick add/remove round-trip with a spec-set-label-* name. System Information renders eight .system-path-item entries each with a non-empty <code>.
explanation: Generated manually from specs/settings.yaml after inspecting templates/settings/index.html, routes/settings.py, static/settings/index.js, static/searchable-select.js, yaffo/i18n.py (locale labels), yaffo/distance_units.py, and translations/es. Fixed two issues found while running: the locale/distance Save buttons are form-level siblings (the original parent-of-select locator hung), and 'Database Path:' needs exact-text matching. Validated with npm run typecheck and a green run (7/7) against the isolated environment.
